dict.string: Aven opens project folders you choose, including Desktop.
Aven opens project folders you choose, including Documents.
Aven opens project folders you choose, including Downloads.
Aven lets websites use your camera only when you approve their request.
Aven listens when you press the microphone in the message box, and lets websites use it only when you approve their request.
Aven turns what you say into words on this Mac when you press the microphone in the message box.
Aven lets websites use your location only when you approve their request.
Aven lets websites connect to local devices and services only when you approve their request.
Aven's built-in browser may check Bluetooth devices for website and sign-in features. You control Bluetooth access in macOS.
